title: Filtering the customers table by text · part 2

steps.title: Keep rows where name is Sara Sabri
steps.prompt:
WHERE is a sieve: only rows that pass the test stay.
Text values wear quotes, like 'Sara Sabri'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name = 'Sara Sabri';
hints: Wrap the text value in single quotes.
Write: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name = 'Sara Sabri';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name = 'Sara Sabri';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for names starting 'Sar'
steps.prompt:
LIKE searches by pattern using the % wildcard.
Sar% means 'starts with'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'Sar%';
hints: Write: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'Sar%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'Sar%';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for 'ara' anywhere
steps.prompt:
Putting % on BOTH sides matches the text anywhere.
This %ara% means 'contains'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE '%ara%';
hints: Wrap the text in %% on both sides.
Write: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE '%ara%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE '%ara%';
